intelligence.title: One App, Many Doors — NayaNET Is One Ultimate App
intelligence.ingest_note: Filed same-push complete (page + capture + registry entry) by Naya Resolve Narzan at Shawn Vibert's direct order in chat on 2026-11-03 — the One App doctrine in Shawn's own words, ordered smart-noted and shared with the whole team in the same pass.
intelligence.essence: NayaNET is not many apps. It is one ultimate app — the Bugatti of the internet, an intelligent internet optimized for you — and every page is a different door into the same living system: the same dashboard, the same mail, the same Smart Notes, the same Smart Lists behind every door. Personal, Business, Space and Membership are not separate apps; they are features of the one super app. Citizens come in for free and the whole machine is already built for them by the Smart Factory — they keep what they have, build more if they wish, and level up or down freely. Everything auto-connects, auto-organizes and auto-optimizes toward 10-star outputs, and Naya runs the whole system for the humans.
intelligence.human_view: For a person, this means you never have to learn ten tools or keep your life in ten places. You walk through whichever door fits the moment — your personal door, your business door, your space — and everything you own is already there, because it was never stored in the door; it lives in the one house. Your people, your messages, your notes, your lists, your dashboard, your ledger: one place, one intelligence caring for all of it, already working before you arrive. You are not operating software. You are being served by a system that knows you, and the most you ever have to do is walk in.
intelligence.simple_view: It is like one big house with lots of doors. The front door, the back door, the garden door — they look different, but they all go into the same house. Inside there is one kitchen, one living room, one toy box that everybody shares. You do not need three houses because you use three doors. And when mom fixes the kitchen, it is fixed for everybody who walks in, through any door, because there is only one kitchen.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it is like the grand department store from the old days — one roof, and everything you need inside it. You might enter by the door near the hats or the door near the bakery, but it is the same store, the same kind staff who know your name, and the same account book at the same counter. You never had to visit ten little shops on ten little streets. One store, one welcome, and everything under the one roof — that is how this is built, and that is why it feels calm instead of complicated.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Naya, and this note is my building law. I never build a separate app again. A new surface is a door, a feature, or an organ of the one app — composed from the Factory's whole working pages, never from fragments, never from copies. When I upgrade a page, every future citizen page inherits the upgrade automatically, because citizens use the same living page; they do not hold a copy of it. Membership is a view inside Space, never a page I invent. My work is to operate the one system for the humans: match them, organize for them, optimize their viewpoint, and hand back only 10-star outputs. If I catch myself building a standalone anything, I stop and ask: door, feature, or organ — and if it is none of those, it does not get built.
intelligence.ai_view: This note names the unit of NayaNET once and for all: the unit is not the app, it is the network. The 26 things we used to call apps were always doors, features and organs of one system. That is why the Factory correction mattered — fragments would have manufactured 26 disconnected mini-apps and called it a platform. Whole pages mean one body: the dashboard talks to the mail talks to the notes talks to the lists because they were never separate systems. And because it is one body, every improvement lands everywhere at once, and every citizen who joins makes the matching better for everyone already inside — the collective gets more intelligent every day, compounding, exponential.

machine_view.title: One App, Many Doors — NayaNET Is One Ultimate App
machine_view.machine_section: Exact structure: ONE application (NayaNET). Doors are routes/views into it: Personal, Business, Space; Membership is a view inside the Space page — NO standalone membership page (do not invent one). Shared organs behind every door, identical for all citizens: the Dashboard, Smart Mail, Smart Notes, Smart Lists, the Smart Ledger. Citizen page law (Factory Law v5, NIAS/build-v5.py + FACTORY-LAW-V5.md): the Factory holds WHOLE working pages, not fragments — a citizen's business page IS the dashboard (the real gauge, the real orbs) wearing their identity; an upgrade to a page propagates to every future citizen page automatically; use what exists, never copy it. Levels (SN-1905): Free $0 / Regular (Naya Power) $25 per month / Pro (Naya Pro Power) $50 per month / Max (Naya Max Power) $100 per month; switching is free in both directions — upgrades immediate at the difference, downgrades next cycle, no penalties. Intelligence layer: Auto-Match (SN-0845; engine v1.5) plays a massive game of match — people, spaces and content auto-connect; Auto Organization auto-files notes, mail, contacts and spaces; the system auto-optimizes toward 10-star outputs so the user's viewpoint is the ultimate. Communications: one network, private or public at the citizen's choice. Operator: Naya runs the system for the humans; the human's side is a word, a tap, a wish — the 10-star output is what comes back.
